messages:
Priya (PM): Heads-up — we need a cross-func design review for RFC: dynamic routing fallback. Need agenda owner, decision-log owner, and 2-3 possible slots. Keeping it short: 30–45m.
Alex (Eng): I can own the agenda. Prefer Fri morning but can do Thu if needed.
Jia (Eng): Thu 10am works for eng team. Fri morning is tight for me.
Sam (Design): Thu is ok from design side, but prefer 11am so folks on west coast can join.
Marta (Product Ops): I can take the decision log + notes if someone confirms.
Priya (PM): Great — options then: Thu 11:00-11:45 PT or Fri 09:30-10:15 PT. Alex volunteers agenda; Marta owns decision log. Any blockers?
Alex (Eng): No blockers. Agenda I propose: 1) Context + goals (5m) 2) Routing policy variants (10m) 3) Rollout strategy / guardrails (10m) 4) Open Qs & next steps (10m). Add a quick code-review status check.
Jia (Eng): Will open the PR today and add link — please add CR status to agenda.
Sam (Design): Can we include a short UX verification checklist in the notes? 5 mins.
Priya (PM): Yep. Alex — can you add the PR link and UX checklist to the agenda doc?
Alex (Eng): Yep, done — added PR: https://git.company/repo/PR-482 and a one-paragraph UX checklist.
Marta (Product Ops): I'll capture decision owner tags in the notes and push to the decision-log repo after the meeting.
Priya (PM): Poll: thumbs up for Thu 11? react with :+1: for Thu, :calendar: for Fri.
Jia (Eng): :+1: (Thu)
Sam (Design): :+1: (Thu)
Alex (Eng): :calendar: (pref Fri) — but will make Thu work if majority prefers.
Marta (Product Ops): :+1: (Thu)
Priya (PM): Looks like Thu 11 wins. @calendar-bot can you create the event and invite eng/product/design + notes link?
calendar-bot: Event created — "RFC: dynamic routing fallback (design review)" Thu 11:00-11:45 PT. Agenda doc: https://docs.company/rfc-dynamic-routing. Invites sent to participants.
Alex (Eng): Thanks — I'll start the agenda doc with the sections.
Jia (Eng): I'll paste a short perf microbenchmark summary before the meeting.
Sam (Design): I'll add the UX checklist to the doc too.
Priya (PM): Final ask — if anyone has priority disputes or blockers, drop them in the doc under "Pre-meeting risks" by EOD. We'll call out tradeoffs during the review.
Alex (Eng): Noted. Adding two tradeoffs I want to highlight: cold-start latency vs cache complexity.
Marta (Product Ops): Copy — I'll surface any stakeholder conflicts in the decision-log pre-read.
Priya (PM): Cool — see you Thu. Thanks all. :party_popper:
Alex (Eng): See ya.
Jia (Eng): Thanks!
